pred_a: All15 envelope/independent normal solve controls and exact-overlap control pass; each fit remains finite and dense penalized replay <1e-8.
pred_b: At least one penalty/optimizer setting recovers >=4/5 planted cases within1% unpenalized coefficient error, using best of two random starts.
selection: Require ten valid runs per setting; select lowest geometric mean of raw reconstruction errors across those ten runs, retaining all failures. Report original penalized fitting objective separately.
null: Positive core penalty prevents singular solves but does not recover the unknown shared dictionaries.
scope: Five unchanged supported targets, original widths, same budgets. rho adds an explicit rotation-invariant private-core amplitude penalty; it is not a sparsity count. No native fit without toy interpretation.
